datasets.title: Debt, interest, health and education by country
datasets.description: General government debt, revenue and net interest in 2025 (IMF Fiscal Monitor, October 2026), with government health spending (WHO) and education spending (UNESCO), latest year, all as % of GDP.

datasets.title: Debt and interest by country group, 2001 to 2031
datasets.description: World debt (IMF World Economic Outlook) and debt, net interest and interest as a share of revenue for advanced, emerging and low-income economies (IMF Fiscal Monitor). 2026 onward are IMF projections.

datasets.title: UK debt interest by financial year
datasets.description: Central government net interest payable and public sector current receipts, £ billion, 1997/98 to 2026/27 (ONS). 2026/27 is April to September.

datasets.title: UK public sector net debt, monthly
datasets.description: Public sector net debt excluding public sector banks, % of GDP, March 1993 to September 2026 (ONS).

datasets.title: Map classes
datasets.description: Bands used to colour the three maps.

datasets.description: Published figures from UNCTAD's A World of Debt 2026, the World Bank's International Debt Report 2025 and the ONS.
